summary: Screening STZ
plan the screen

The assessment will begin by reviewing Constellation Brands' 10-K to evaluate the permissibility of its beverage portfolio and revenue mix under Shariah guidelines. Using Zetaris-sourced SEC data, financial ratios including interest-bearing debt, cash, securities, receivables, total assets, revenue, interest income, and market cap will be computed to determine fiscal compliance and purification requirements.
